notes.title: MarksmanVR is officially released on steam.
notes.content:
After one year of development, MarksmanVR is finally released! MarksmanVR is an archery defense games like any other games in same genre.I spent most time on enchancing archery experience itself. I'm confident with these features, I suggest you to check these out.:)

- Bow mechanic: I've revised it dozen times. Then i've realized there isn't bow that perfect for everone.
- Tried to offer best archery experience for everyone, added some options like 'adjust draw length'
- Graphics quality
- Trajectoy prediction for beginners
- Various hand visualization options(Hide, hand, arm)

I hope you enjoy my game.

notes.title: Updates in v0.9.3.3
notes.content:
1. Oculus support
- tutorial
- corrected controller offset rotation
- turned player direction for 180 degree tracking users(still 360 tracking is recommended for some levels)

2. Gameplay
- Changed vantage points in stage 5, 8
- Reduced blood splat, player recovers from bloody mess quicker than before
- When player is dead, blood splat does not block player's sight anymore
- Catapult & Trebuchet sound become louder & noticeable
- Combo bug fixed: powershot does not effects combo streaks

3. Now player can accesss to menu by pressing menu button in Oculus touch or Vive. Menu can be pop-up before stage started or after cleared.

4. New trailer is ready, you can check what has changed after early access!

notes.title: Updates in v0.9.1.4
notes.content:
[h1]Updates in v0.9.1.4 [/h1]

- DRAMATIC change in bow and arrow mechanics. you MUST play this patch.
 (2.5x projectile speed, arrow drop won't bother you anymore)
- Now collision and homing arrow will work flawlessly.
- Dead horse won't affect enemy's navigation.
- Now mirror window in desktop will be rendered 16:9 resolution(better for capture), however it will be stretched, when your monitor has different ratio(do resize captured video, instead of crop in this case)

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=939823216

[h1] Upcoming in v0.9.1.5 [/h1]
- Change bow model for better aiming, which have one-sided hole in aim center like many others do.
- Correct the transform of hand while pulling back an arrow
- Add arrow pulling sound
- Everything about bow, arm, hand, arrow and shooting mechanism will be improved as far as i can imagine.ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Updates in v0.9.1.2
notes.content:
- Added stage1 boss - minotaur, you can meet him at stage 3(replay is recommended for those already cleared this level)
- Added some interactive stuffs in worldmap, let's find out!
- Now horse is become smarter, they won't block enemy's spawn point (changed point of retreat)
- Now arms can be stretched, this helps your virtual hand fits into bow and arrow, no matter how long player's arm length is.
- Tuned bow mechanics : now arrow speed is more controllable.
(previously arrow's initial speed can be 2m/s to 20m/s, now 0.5m/s to 22m/s)
I think this numbers are about right. because my intention about distant target is, it should be challenging.(aim higher)[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/636950/discussions/0/1290691308579820248/]  let's discuss about this. [/url]
